title: [3.0-beta/2.8.2.18-dev] NSClient Profile display (window top) is not always updated according to the stored profile.
symptom: When a profile is changed in AAPS (e.g., DIA from 7.0h to 9.0h) and activated, the top window display in NSClient is not always updated to reflect the change, even though the profile in NSClient is updated. This happens when the second profile edit is done soon after the first, but works if waiting 1-2 minutes.
cause: The issue is related to Nightscout synchronization; events must be at least 1 minute apart for proper sync.
fix: Use the NS dev branch for proper sync, as stated by the maintainer.
evidence_quote: So far events must be at least 1 min off each other for proper sync
